title: Uniform Boundedness Conjecture for Rational Points
exact_target: Can the number of rational points on every smooth curve of genus at least two be bounded using only its genus and the degree of its number field?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1470 (ALG-015). CC BY 4.0.

Eric Katz, Joseph Rabinoff and David Zureick-Brown, Uniform Bounds for the Number of Rational Points on Curves of Small Mordell–Weil Rank, arXiv:1504.00694v3 (2017), abstract and Section 1, full uniform-bound conjecture preceding Theorem 1.1.
